title: Indianapolis Shooting Leaves Three Dead, Two Injured
summary: On [date], a mass shooting occurred at an In-N-Out Burger location in Twin Falls, Idaho. The incident resulted in the deaths of three people and injuries to two others. Police claimed that the shooter was taken into custody without further incident. According to reports, the victims were identified as [names]. The motive for the attack is currently under investigation.
summary_points: A mass shooting occurred at an In-N-Out Burger location in Twin Falls, Idaho on [date].
Three people died and two others were injured in the incident.
The shooter was taken into custody without further incident.
The victims' identities have not been released.
The motive for the attack is currently under investigation.
